l-n20261017-affliction-boards.summary: Human still leads Affliction at 755.7 DPS with Orc 0.81% behind. Cleansed Vilebranch Icon and Jewel of the Guard Captain are now the joint best trinkets at +3.28%.
l-n20261017-affliction-boards.title: MythicSim re-runs Affliction race and trinket boards on client 70425

m-n20261017-manor-mistmantle.summary: Bind on Forever spotted a Manor Mistmantle dungeon in the game files. Blizzard hasn't announced it and nothing confirms it for launch.
m-n20261017-manor-mistmantle.title: Found in the files: Manor Mistmantle

n20261018-mythicsim-17oct-resim.summary: Arcane jumps to 837 DPS and now leads Fire (797) by 5%; Frost rises to 673. Demonology (853) and Affliction (757) barely move, and the tier list still shows the 16 Oct run.
n20261018-mythicsim-17oct-resim.title: MythicSim re-sims Mage and Warlock on a 17 Oct engine

n20261019-capital-city-fixes.summary: Darnassus gets a mailbox next to its Auction House, and an invisible wall between the Stormwind barber shop area and the Auction House has been removed.
n20261019-capital-city-fixes.title: Small capital city fixes in the beta

n20261019-forever-open-warlocks.summary: A Warlock won the $50,000 top prize at the level-30 Forever Open, and Warlocks took first and second place. Icy Veins says Mages gave them their hardest matches.
n20261019-forever-open-warlocks.title: Warlocks win the Forever Open duel tournament

n20261019-mythicsim-tier-resim.summary: The tier list moved to an 18 Oct engine and the Warlock and Mage pages to a 19 Oct one. Arcane (861) and Fire (851) climb to #6 and #8, Demonology sims 873 on the newest Warlock run, and Shadow reaches 774 on its newest board.
n20261019-mythicsim-tier-resim.title: MythicSim re-runs the tier list and Warlock and Mage pages

n20261019-new-zones-video.summary: A new Blizzard video previews two new levelling zones: the Riverglades, reached by a new path from Redridge Mountains, and Mount Hyjal. No level ranges were given.
n20261019-new-zones-video.title: Blizzard video shows the Riverglades and Mount Hyjal zones

n20261020-mythicsim-mage-race-boards.summary: MythicSim's 20 Oct Arcane and Fire race boards (engine 15b7435) top out at 785.7 for Arcane, down from 862.0, and 844.8 for Fire, down from 850.7. Human now edges Skyborne for Fire; the Mage class page hasn't been re-run on this engine yet.
n20261020-mythicsim-mage-race-boards.title: New MythicSim engine puts Arcane about 9% lower on the race boards

n20261020-mythicsim-tier-list-18oct.summary: Demonology climbs from #7 to #5 at 873 DPS, Affliction from #13 to #12 and Fire from #8 to #7, while Shadow stays #14 but now at 774. The Hunter rows moved to a 19 Oct run and dropped 6 to 7%, so only Survival is left in S.
n20261020-mythicsim-tier-list-18oct.title: MythicSim tier list moves every Warlock, Mage and Priest row to its 18 Oct engine

p-n02-2026-10-16.summary: New race sims include the reworked racials. Human leads at 747 DPS; the spread across all six races is 1.7%.
p-n02-2026-10-16.title: Human is now the top Shadow Priest race

p-n03-2026-10-16.summary: Shadow tree now shows Dark Inspiration; Shadow Affinity, Improved Fade and Improved Vampiric Embrace are gone.
p-n03-2026-10-16.title: TalentsForever updated to build 70425

p-n20261016-found-in-the-files-improved-.summary: Wowhead's datamine shows the reworked talent no longer adds 5 yards of range or a 35% slow. Blizzard's notes didn't mention this.
p-n20261016-found-in-the-files-improved-.title: Found in the files: Improved Mind Flay lost its range and slow

p-n20261016-found-in-the-files-mental-st.summary: The Discipline talent moved to row 2 and dropped from 3% to 2% Intellect per rank.
p-n20261016-found-in-the-files-mental-st.title: Found in the files: Mental Strength cut to 2% Intellect per rank

p-n20261016-found-in-the-files-moonkin-a.summary: Raids with both Druid auras get both bonuses. Moonkin Aura gives spell crit to every caster, you included.
p-n20261016-found-in-the-files-moonkin-a.title: Found in the files: Moonkin Aura and Leader of the Pack now stack

p-n20261016-found-in-the-files-shadow-wo.summary: Blizzard's notes say the cooldown rose from 12 to 18 sec, but game data shows it was 15 before the patch.
p-n20261016-found-in-the-files-shadow-wo.title: Found in the files: Shadow Word: Death was 15 sec, not 12

p-n20261016-server-slam-moved-to-21-octo.summary: Blizzard has pushed the free stress test back two days to 21 October. Europe opens at 19:00 CEST (6pm UK) and Blizzard says it may end early or run late.
p-n20261016-server-slam-moved-to-21-octo.title: Server Slam moved to 21 October

x-n20261017-tier-bonuses.summary: Manaflare Regalia's 5-piece boosts Frostfire Bolt procs and crit during Combustion. Raiments of Conviction's 5-piece cuts Devouring Plague's cooldown by 60 sec, which predates the 24-sec rework.
x-n20261017-tier-bonuses.title: Mage and Shadow Priest tier bonuses in the files

n20261020-mythicsim-fire-overtakes-arcan.summary: MythicSim's tier list and class pages moved to engine b5c0b8b on 20 Oct. Fire Mage rises to 843 DPS (#6) while Arcane falls to 784 (#10); Demonology Warlock is 869 (#5) and Shadow Priest 771 (#13).
n20261020-mythicsim-fire-overtakes-arcan.title: MythicSim 20 Oct run: Fire Mage overtakes Arcane

n20261021-mage-hotfix.title: Unannounced Mage hotfix: Piercing Ice removed, Elemental Precision cut to 3 ranks
n20261021-mage-hotfix.summary: A server hotfix to build 70425 on 20 Oct removed Frost's Piercing Ice and cut Elemental Precision from 5 ranks to 3, and moved four Frost talents within their rows. Blizzard hasn't posted notes; TalentsForever and players on the official forums report it.

n20261021-beta-extended.title: Beta extended to 23 October; stress test times confirmed
n20261021-beta-extended.summary: Blizzard says the Stress Test runs 18:00 to 02:00 UK time on 21 Oct, after which the beta reopens and then closes for good at 19:00 CEST on Friday 23 October.

n20261021-name-reservation.title: Early name reservation opens 27 October at 18:00 CET
n20261021-name-reservation.summary: Upgrade-pack owners can reserve names from 27 October to 3 November, up to three characters in total across all rulesets.

n20261021-raid-overview.title: Blizzard raid overview: Hyjal Summit has 13 bosses, raids reset weekly
n20261021-raid-overview.summary: Blizzard's raid preview confirms Barrow Deeps (10 players, eight bosses), Hyjal Summit (20 players, 13 bosses) and Onyxia's Lair (40, Drakefire Amulet needed) all unlock 9 December, with weekly resets planned.

n20261021-dungeon-levels.title: Blizzard lists the nine new dungeons and their level ranges
n20261021-dungeon-levels.summary: Blizzard's dungeon article gives official ranges from Hall of Thanes (13–18) to Shaper's Terrace (58–60); four are narrower than the ranges this site had.

n20261021-mythicsim-62b7445.title: MythicSim 21 Oct run: Demonology and Fire up, Frost Mage drops to C
n20261021-mythicsim-62b7445.summary: On engine 62b7445 Demonology rises to 885 and Fire to 860; Arcane climbs to #9 and Frost Mage slips into the C band at 666.

n20261022-mythicsim-a667dce.title: MythicSim re-runs the tier list on engine a667dce: Frostfire up, Marksmanship down
n20261022-mythicsim-a667dce.summary: A second 21 Oct run moves every row to engine a667dce. Frostfire Mage rises from 744 to 768 DPS and Demonology moves up to #4 as Marksmanship Hunter drops to 904; your other specs keep their numbers.

n20261022-camping-guide.title: Blizzard explains camping and every camp feature
n20261022-camping-guide.summary: Blizzard's camping article confirms each player adds one feature to a shared campfire, you sit for a minute to get the buffs, and all features share a one-hour cooldown. It also gives the level 60 values and which class buff each one clashes with.

n20261023-mythicsim-22oct.title: MythicSim 22 Oct re-run: Demonology to #2, Shadow Priest into the A band
n20261023-mythicsim-22oct.summary: New reference-build changes on engine a667dce lift most casters: Demonology 885 to 936 DPS (#2), Fire 860 to 915 (#4), Affliction 784 to 827 and Shadow Priest 771 to 804, now A band.

n20261023-rp-pvp.title: Roleplay-PvP ruleset confirmed for launch
n20261023-rp-pvp.summary: Blizzard developer Aggrend says a Roleplay-PvP ruleset will be added for launch on 4 November, and Blizzard is working to let players pick it when name reservation opens on 27 October.

n20261023-beta-celebration.title: Beta ends with a 24-hour farewell event
n20261023-beta-celebration.summary: Blizzard is running a one-off celebration in the starting zones until the beta closes at 10am PDT (6pm UK) on 23 October. Blizzard says its items and experiences will almost certainly not be part of the launched game.

n20261023-beta-only-items.title: Found in the files: beta-only Molten Core loot for the farewell event
n20261023-beta-only-items.summary: ForeverChanges found 127 beta-only items in a 22 Oct hotfix, including level 1 copies of Molten Core loot and the Tier 1 sets, plus an elixir that triples experience for an hour. Nothing in it points to Molten Core on the live realms.

n20261024-beta-closed.title: Beta closed; character creation opens 27 October
n20261024-beta-closed.summary: Blizzard has closed the beta and will spend a few days on priority fixes before the 4 November launch. Character creation, including ruleset choice and name reservation, opens on Tuesday 27 October.

n20261025-mythicsim-resim.title: MythicSim re-sim: Demonology joins the S band, Destruction climbs to #9
n20261025-mythicsim-resim.summary: MythicSim re-ran its Forever boards on 24 to 25 Oct. Demonology rises to 959 DPS and into the S band, while a new Shadow Bolt reference build lifts Destruction from 759 to 847 and from #15 to #9; Shadow Priest drops back to the B band at 816.

n20261025-final-beta-build.title: Final beta build 70532 confirmed, no class changes
n20261025-final-beta-build.summary: Bind on Forever and ForeverChanges both list 1.60.1.70532 (22 Oct) as the last beta build, with no spell or item changes in the client files.

n20261026-layering-fixes.title: Blizzard promises layering fixes before launch
n20261026-layering-fixes.summary: Blizzard told the press it will keep groups together on boats and zeppelins and stop big groups being split across layers at capital cities. It also said some layering will always happen on Forever's high-capacity servers; the fixes are promised, not yet live.
n20261026-layering-fixes.source: Output Lag (Blizzard statement), also Kami Labs

n20261026-mythicsim-race-resim.title: MythicSim re-sims its race boards; Fire and Frostfire now sim as Human
n20261026-mythicsim-race-resim.summary: MythicSim re-ran 30 of its 34 race boards for the 16 Oct client, and Human now leads Fire and Frostfire. With Human as their preset race, Fire sims 916 DPS and Frostfire 809, and Fire slips to #5 of 24 behind a re-simmed Marksmanship Hunter.

n20261027-final-racial-tuning.title: Final racial tuning before launch
n20261027-final-racial-tuning.summary: Blizzard cut Human Ruthless to 1% crit but doubled The Human Spirit to 10%, swapped Orc Savage for Command (+5% Warlock and Hunter pet damage), gave Dwarves 1% hit instead of Earth Fury and cut Skyborne haste to 2%. It says racial identity now comes first, so some races will be slightly better at some roles.

n20261027-mythicsim-racial-resim.title: MythicSim re-sims every spec for the new racials
n20261027-mythicsim-racial-resim.summary: Demonology stays #2 at 949 DPS (was 959) and Orc now tops its race board. Fire is 917 (#6), Arcane 830 (#11) and Shadow 812 (#13); MythicSim's default list now has 22 specs, with the Smite and Elehance hybrids moved to its All playstyles view.

n20261027-found-in-the-files-spellstone-.title: Found in the files: Spellstone is Shadow only, Winter's Chill reworked
n20261027-found-in-the-files-spellstone-.summary: MythicSim says beta client 70630 makes the Spellstone's spell damage Shadow only and changes Winter's Chill to come only from Frostbolt, Frost Blast and Fingers of Frost Ice Lance. TalentsForever lists 70630 but no Mage talent change, so treat this as unconfirmed.

n20261028-racial-additions.title: Blizzard adds three racial changes it left out on 26 Oct
n20261028-racial-additions.summary: Blizzard updated its beta notes on 27 Oct: Orc Blood Fury now has a 2 minute cooldown (was 3), Troll Berserking lasts 15 seconds (was 10) and Undead Touch of the Grave can proc every 15 seconds (was 25). It also confirmed that Skyborne's Attuned and Charged buffs survive death but end when you enter a raid.

n20261028-mythicsim-racial-resim.title: MythicSim re-sims for the extra racial changes
n20261028-mythicsim-racial-resim.summary: Demonology moves to an Orc reference and edges up to 952 DPS, still #2 and S band. Undead now ties Human for top Destruction race and closes on Night Elf for Shadow; every other tracked spec's DPS is unchanged.

n20261029-found-70685-mage.title: Found in the files: build 70685 reshuffles Mage talents
n20261029-found-70685-mage.summary: ForeverChanges reads a 28 Oct server build where Precision gives 2/4/6% hit to all spells, Incineration grows to 5 ranks (10% crit) and Critical Mass shrinks to 3 ranks (6%), Ice Lance gets an 8 sec cooldown and Arcane Focus and Frost Blast go. Nothing confirmed by Blizzard yet and only one site reports it.

n20261029-found-70685-tent.title: Found in the files: Adventurer's Tent now builds Rested XP
n20261029-found-70685-tent.summary: The same 28 Oct build turns the Adventurer's Tent into a camp that raises the Rested experience of you and nearby party members to 20% of a level, instead of a plain 15 minute tent. Unconfirmed, one source.

n20261030-mythicsim-arms-hunter.title: MythicSim tunes Arms and Hunters; Shadow slips to #14
n20261030-mythicsim-arms-hunter.summary: MythicSim's 29 Oct snapshot moves Arms Warrior to 817 DPS after a rotation fix, one place above Shadow, which is unchanged at 812. Hunter timing fixes lift Survival to 1,230 and trim Marksmanship to 939 and Beast Mastery to 859.

n20261030-found-70707.title: Found in the files: build 70707 buffs Revenge and makes the tent cosmetic again
n20261030-found-70707.summary: ForeverChanges says client build 70707 of 30 Oct adds attack power scaling to Warrior Revenge and turns the Adventurer's Tent back into a 15 minute cosmetic tent, undoing the Rested XP version found in build 70685. Unofficial and from one site; Blizzard has posted no notes and nothing for Priest.

n20261031-found-hotfix-swd.title: Found in the files: 30 Oct hotfix triples Shadow Word: Death's backlash
n20261031-found-hotfix-swd.summary: An unannounced hotfix to build 70707 makes Shadow Word: Death hit you for 30% of your maximum health when the target survives, up from 10%, and swaps Binding Heal in the Holy tree for Holy Binding. ForeverChanges and TalentsForever both list it; Blizzard has posted no notes.

n20261031-found-hotfix-mage.title: Found in the files: 30 Oct hotfix buffs Ice Lance and Winter's Chill
n20261031-found-hotfix-mage.summary: The same unannounced hotfix gives Ice Lance +300% damage on frozen targets again (with an 8 sec cooldown at every rank), lifts Winter's Chill to 20% per stack for your next Cone of Cold, and weakens Arcane Blast's stacks to 12% of Intellect. It also reworks the Paladin and Druid talent trees.

n20261031-mythicsim-mage-tree.title: MythicSim re-sims Mages: Frost up 14%, Fire down to 900
n20261031-mythicsim-mage-tree.summary: MythicSim moved its Mage references to client 70707's talent tree and the 30 Oct hotfix. Fire drops from 917 to 900 but stays the top Mage spec, Frost climbs from 677 to 769 and out of the C band, and Shadow Priest moves back to #13 as Arms Warrior slips.

n20261101-mythicsim-ret.title: MythicSim adopts a new Retribution build; Ret jumps to #4
n20261101-mythicsim-ret.summary: MythicSim's Retribution reference now uses a community Unsealed Wrath build that twists Seal of Fury with Seal of Righteousness, taking it from 859 to 941 DPS. This is a sim build change, not a game change; Shadow stays #13 at 812.

n20261102-mythicsim-aq20-book-ranks.title: MythicSim drops Ahn'Qiraj book ranks; Shadow rises to #11 and the A band
n20261102-mythicsim-aq20-book-ranks.summary: MythicSim's sims no longer use spell ranks taught by Ahn'Qiraj 20 books, since its boards model characters without raid drops. Most DPS specs lose 1% to 5% and Frost Mage 7%, while Shadow Priest is unaffected at 812 and climbs from #13 to #11.

n20261103-blizzard-notes-nov2.title: Blizzard posts its last beta notes before launch: more damage, more creature health
n20261103-blizzard-notes-nov2.summary: Blizzard's final development notes gather every change since 15 October: classes deal more damage and higher-level creatures have more health to match. It plans no big tuning changes before the raids open, then a large pass once players are past level 30.

n20261103-blizzard-shadow.title: Blizzard confirms the Shadow Word: Death backlash and fixes Cure Disease in Shadowform
n20261103-blizzard-shadow.summary: Shadow Word: Death now costs 30% of your maximum health if the target survives (was 10%), but no longer hurts you on a miss. Cure Disease and Abolish Disease no longer drop you out of Shadowform, and Vampiric Embrace can no longer crit.

n20261103-blizzard-warlock.title: Blizzard notes: Wrack more than doubled, Shadow and Flame doubled, demons lose health
n20261103-blizzard-warlock.summary: Wrack's base damage per second at level 60 rises from 36 to 86 with twice the spell damage coefficient, and Shadow and Flame now gives up to 20%. Demons get far less health from your Stamina, and Spellstones only boost Shadow damage.

n20261103-blizzard-mage.title: Blizzard notes: Frost Blast removed, Ice Barrier now boosts Frost damage
n20261103-blizzard-mage.summary: Frost Blast is gone, and Ice Barrier now gives 15% more Frost damage for a minute plus 5% while it holds. Missile Barrage moves to row 2 and Ignite now works on all of Flamestrike.

n20261103-blizzard-training.title: Training 1 to 60 now costs about 207 gold for every class
n20261103-blizzard-training.summary: Blizzard evened out training costs so every class pays between 206 and 207 gold for its abilities from 1 to 60. New spells no longer land on your action bars by themselves, and respawns are faster in starting zones for the launch rush.

n20261103-found-hunter-hotfix.title: Found in the files: 3 Nov hotfix raises Hunter damage
n20261103-found-hunter-hotfix.summary: ForeverChanges reads a 3 Nov hotfix, with no Blizzard notes, that gives back Aspect of the Hawk's attack power, doubles Trueshot Aura and raises Aimed Shot, Arcane Shot, Serpent Sting and Sniper Shot damage. MythicSim's tier list is still on the 30 Oct hotfix, so Hunter ranks may rise when it re-sims.

n20261103-mythicsim-bis.title: MythicSim adds pre-raid BiS lists and profession gains
n20261103-mythicsim-bis.summary: MythicSim now has a pre-raid best-in-slot page for every spec and lists what each profession adds. Shadow gains nothing measurable from any profession, while Mages and Warlocks gain 0.9% to 3.2% from Tailoring for their class robe.

n20261104-mythicsim-2-nov-notes-simmed.title: MythicSim sims Blizzard's 2 Nov notes: Shadow falls to #20
n20261104-mythicsim-2-nov-notes-simmed.summary: MythicSim's 4 Nov tier list includes the 2 Nov development notes. Rogues and Shamans jump 30% to 40% and Arcane passes Fire on a new arc fire build, while Shadow stays at 812 DPS and drops from #11 to #20 of 22.

n20261104-build-70755-technical.title: Client build 70755 is a technical build
n20261104-build-70755-technical.summary: Build 1.60.1.70755 arrived on 3 Nov. ForeverChanges and Bind on Forever both say it has no spell, talent or item changes compared with build 70753.

n20261104-launch-notes-checked.title: Fan check: Priest, Mage and Warlock changes from the 2 Nov notes are in
n20261104-launch-notes-checked.summary: Bind on Forever compared build 70755 and live server data with Blizzard's 2 Nov notes and found the Priest, Mage, Warlock and racial changes in. Some Feral Druid, Starfire and tank threat changes were still missing, though threat may be set server-side.

n20261104-gamepad.title: Blizzard: gamepad support in WoW Forever
n20261104-gamepad.summary: Blizzard published a guide to playing WoW Forever with a gamepad. Support is in a beta state, with more improvements promised.
